Power 
 Station

Technical 
 Procedure
Equipment:Governor Air Compressor
E22.5 - 15/Se/Sz - 3 stages
BAUER - Germany
Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I2, 
which must be performed every two years or 2000 hours operation as indicated by Y2 
in the title block.

This 
compressor serves in compressing air for the governors and breaks of the main 
turbine units 3-9

The first draft 
was initiated by eng. Ashraf Saber, tested by eng. Alsayed Ibrahim El ashmony, 
accepted by general director eng. Abd elghaffar Osman, approved by eng. 
Mohamed Abd elbaset head sector of Aswan Dam (1&2) power stations and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control 
general director.
Technical specifications

Type of 
compressor : E22.5 - 15/Se/Sz - 3 stages - BAUER - Germany

Air 
flow rate (Q) : 850 L/min Max. pressure 
(P) : 40 bar
Revolution (N): 1150 I/min
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear your safety equipment as helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc
Close outlet air valve of compressor
Discharge the pressure air in the compressor system

Complete maintenance tool set
Compressed air hose for cleaning
Cleaning articles (fluid, rags, ...etc)
Required oil for compressor (Rarus 829)

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Change inlet suction 
filter (OQFA 12 AT 001)
Check inlet - exhaust valves for first stage (OQFA 12 AN 100)
Change inlet - exhaust valves for second stage (OQFA 12 AN 200)
Change inlet - exhaust valves for third stage (OQFA 12 AN 300)
Check the condition of pistin, rings

Check for leaks and correct as necessary for the 
compressor - coolers (OQFA12AT101- 3)
Empty the oil tank of the compressor
Replace pump oil filter of the compressor

Add a new oil in the oil tank of compressor until the correct level (about 8 
liters)
Check V belt tension
Check function of safety valves

Clean the parts indoor compressor and the outer 
surface
Open the outlet air valve of compressor
Check the functions of air compressor operation
